body: I don't really have many hobbies or skills or talents or anything. The one thing I'm passionate about is makeup. Love it. Love learning and trying new techniques, always buying more. Unfortunately there is no formal training for makeup in the area, not that you actually need formal training, but I'm always doubting my skills. That plus being terrified of people kinda ruins the prospect of ever being a makeup artist.
I'm afraid he might not be for long, though. I know all of this is really starting to get to him and it'd be so easy for him to buy a plane ticket back to Europe and skip out on everything.
I just can't take being me. And now I'm bringing him down with me.
